subject: lanternShrine
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: roadside shrine with lanterns, offerings and torii.
Style: Genshin Impact.
reasoning:
I'm planning the module's design: a roadside Inazuma-style shrine scene with a stone base, torii gate, small wooden hokora, paired stone lanterns, hanging paper lanterns, and offerings like sake and fruit, aiming for a moderately rich but correct implementation.

I'm setting up a single root joint to anchor all the parts, then writing helper functions for boxes, cylinders, and colors to keep the ~300-line build manageable, choosing specific colors and dimensions for the torii, platform, and shrine layout. Writing helper functions...

Still shaping the torii outline... I'm planning the nuki crossbeam and a center plaque emblem using simple gold-ring shapes instead of text glyphs, placed on a plane facing forward.

For the shrine building, I'm structuring it as a stacked base box, wood-textured body walls, a door plane, and a pyramidal roof built from a lathed outline that curves from peak to eaves.

For the stone lanterns, I'm placing two at symmetric x-positions, each with a hexagonal base cylinder, pillar, a lamp house box with a warm glowing inner light, a six-sided lathed roof, and a small finial on top, plus thin corner posts for detail.

Now I'm thinking through the hanging paper lanterns at the torii: glowing red-orange ellipsoid shapes with striped texture, dark caps top and bottom, suspended by thin rods. I'm working out the vertical placement so they hang properly from the shimagi crossbeam without colliding with the nuki beam, adjusting the torii's pillar height and beam positions to make the proportions work.

I also realize the shimenawa rope's sagging catenary curve between the pillars could overlap with the lanterns, so I'm repositioning the rope lower, below the nuki, to avoid the conflict while keeping both elements visible and properly spaced.

Now I'm adding the shide paper zigzag streamers hanging from the rope, giving the rope a straw-colored grain texture with tassels at the ends. Then I'm placing a low offering table in front of the shrine with sake bottles, cups, a rice bowl, Genshin-style sunsettia fruits, a dango skewer with three spheres on a plate, mochi, and coins.

I'm building paired kitsune guardian statues using primitive shapes—ellipsoid bodies, spherical heads, conical snouts and ears, a curved tail sweep, and a torus-shaped red bib—mirrored on either side of the shrine entrance, each facing forward. I'm also placing a sakura tree in the back corner with a curved trunk sweep and pink icosphere canopy blobs rendered in flat cel-shading, positioning it and working out the platform dimensions.

Now I'm scattering small flat pink petal cards around the tree for falling-petal effect, adding a glowing purple electro-crystal cluster (octahedral/conical shapes) on a rock near the shrine, laying out box-shaped steps in front of the platform, and placing flat cylindrical stepping stones for the path, while still figuring out the ground/platform base geometry.

Setting up the grass-colored ground disc and stone platform, confirming overall model height sits around 3.5 units with everything resting at y=0, and importing the glow and toon shading kits to apply painted/mottled cel shading across the geometries using world-position-based UVs.

Now I'm planning the plaque texture as an SVG drawn onto a plane positioned between the shimagi and nuki beams, working out the shrine's door texture with gold lattice and vermilion coloring, and placing the shrine platform with its top surface at y=0.15.

For the shrine body, I'm sizing the plinth, posts, and walls with vermilion corners and cream-white panels, then working through the lathe-based roof geometry to get the proportions and spin angle right so the roof corners extend wide enough to cover the body below.

Now I'm adding details around the structure: a gold finial sphere at the peak, a veranda step at the front, an offering table, kitsune figures, lanterns flanking the approach, and a torii gate with pillars positioned further out, plus entrance steps leading up to the platform -- working out the z-coordinates for each so everything lines up in proper sequence from shrine to gate.

Writing shide SVG code...

Defining the rope's catmull-spline path between the torii pillars with a sagging curve, giving it a woven grain texture, and setting up a glowing hanging lantern using a scaled sphere geometry with a lantern texture.
